name: dsh-theme-plugin
description: 在 DSH 设置中统一管理外观和主题，浏览带图片的多来源市场，一键检查安装，并提供失败恢复与 AI 修复说明。
longDescription:
Three native Appearance pages cover appearance settings, theme management and a four-source visual market. Includes six appearances and 29 palettes, existing-theme discovery, file import/export, supported dynamic clients and theme controls. Installation stages and validates packages before activation; failures preserve the previous appearance. Host/adapter changes trigger affected-theme revalidation. Catalog size does not establish compatibility.

Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 exactly, Cordis 4.0.5 and Node.js 22.19+. Verified on macOS: isolated installation of the final archive with all 111 files matching, native three-page settings and real market images, representative static/dynamic theme loading and recovery. Eleven focused checks and GitHub CI passed. Four built-in visual layouts have light/dark title visibility checks. Windows/Linux devices, the full market and all plugin combinations have not been individually verified; backend-dependent themes require explicit service adapters or native linkage. Preflight is compatibility checking, not a security certification.
